raw_text: Iran's MuddyWater Hackers Target Indian Power Grid and Ports in Cyber Campaign. An Iranian state-sponsored hacking group known as MuddyWater has been caught targeting Indian critical infrastructure including power grid operators and port management systems, according to cybersecurity firm Mandiant and India's CERT-In. The attackers used compromised Indian government websites to deliver remote access tools, with command infrastructure traced to IRGC-linked hosting providers in Iran.
